summary: Retested live Studio Voxel backend and browser flows. Public routes, gallery lightbox, contact submission, invalid/valid admin login, dashboard, media empty/upload state, admin logout, and mobile menu/overflow all passed.
action_items: Existing regression test requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported before pytest collection; consider loading frontend/.env in test configuration.
Review the expected 401 console entry generated by the post-logout auth check; no user-facing error or runtime crash was observed.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical implementation issue reproduced in this iteration.
Admin CRUD modal and settings save were not fully exercised in this browser pass; backend core CRUD regression passed.
seed_data_creation: Created a contact submission and a temporary media upload during testing; media was deleted through the admin flow where confirmation was accepted by the browser harness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview tested at the configured public URL. Public routes /, /about, /services, /projects, /gallery, /contact passed; gallery lightbox and contact success passed; invalid and valid login, dashboard, media state/upload, logout, mobile menu and no horizontal overflow passed. One 401 console log appeared during normal unauthenticated auth checking after logout.
rca of the issue: The only observed console error was a 401 response during expected auth validation after logout, while the UI correctly redirected to admin login and showed no error state. Existing pytest collection fails when launched without REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in the shell because the test reads the environment directly; rerunning with the value from frontend/.env yielded 2 passed.
